data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for authentication and sharing with Tencent QQ SDKs on Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter developers to authenticate and share content using native Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS Tencent SDKs. Provides methods for logging in, sharing images or web links, and checking installation status.
use_when: You need QQ authentication in your Flutter application.
You need to share content to QQ or QZone from a Flutter application.
avoid_when: You do not need QQ integration.
You need full feature parity on HarmonyOS (which currently only supports partial functionality like server-side login).
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS.
Integrated native configurations for Android and iOS to simplify setup.
weaknesses: HarmonyOS support is limited to specific methods and server-side login.
Requires proper handling of Universal Links on iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding tencent_kit configuration with app_id and universal_link in pubspec.yaml, and setting up Universal Links for iOS and querySchemes for HarmonyOS.
data.minimal_example:
dependencies:
  tencent_kit: ^6.2.0

tencent_kit:
  app_id: ${your tencent app id}
  universal_link: https://${your applinks domain}/universal_link/${example_app}/qq_conn/${your tencent app id}/
